summary: Fixed bug #57 by changing booking.interval.intersects to half-open comparisons (a.start < b.end and b.start < a.end), matching docs/MODEL.md. This corrects overlaps() and the nightly conflicts() report, which shared the same false positive for back-to-back bookings. Added a regression test for conflicts(); the suite went from 1 failed, 2 passed to 4 passed.
assumptions: Fixed the root cause in intersects rather than only overlaps, because the canonical model is half-open and conflicts() uses the same primitive.
merge_ranges behavior is unchanged: adjacent() still merges touching ranges, so back-to-back bookings still draw as one calendar block.
Zero-length intervals (start == end) now intersect nothing under half-open semantics; no test or doc covers this case.
The nightly conflicts() report should also stop flagging back-to-back bookings, as the model implies.
